ranked_facts.why: The presence of a KDR (VEGFR2) c.C2312G, p.T771R somatic mutation is a distinctive feature that distinguishes Acquired Tufted Angioma with Somatic KDR Mutation from other benign vascular neoplasms, and this specific mutation would not be expected in other conditions like malignant vascular tumors or reactive vascular lesions.

ranked_facts.concept_key: Histopathological findings of discrete clusters of small-caliber vessels
ranked_facts.why: The histopathological findings of discrete clusters of small-caliber vessels are more characteristic of benign vascular neoplasms such as lobular capillary hemangioma, tufted angioma, and acquired tufted angioma, and less typical of malignant vascular tumors.
